Washington State Register, Issue 26-16 WSR 26-16-026A
WSR 26-16-026A
WITHDRAWAL OF PROPOSED RULES
DEPARTMENT OF
LABOR AND INDUSTRIES
[Filed July 28, 2026, 11:43 a.m.]
The department of labor and industries (L&I) is withdrawing the
CR-102 proposed rule making filed on February 3, 2026, and published
under WSR 26-04-112. The comment period for the proposed rule making
was from February 4, 2026, to March 10, 2026.
Due to technology resource constraints and uncertainty about our
ability to prioritize this work, L&I is not able to make system
changes to support the requirements of this rule change. For this rea-
son, we have decided to withdraw the rule making. L&I will revisit im-
plementation and system options, consult with stakeholders, and file a
new CR-101 preproposal if/when appropriate.
If you have any questions, contact Caitlin Gates, rules coordina-
tor, at Caitlin.Gates@Lni.wa.gov or 360-902-6744.
Caitlin Gates
Rules Coordinator
Certified on 8/13/2026 [ 11] WSR Issue 26-16 - Proposed
```
